title: Workopolis Jobs Scraper
description: Fast & stealthy job scraper for Workopolis.com using Next.js API extraction. Scrape job listings with title, company, location, salary, and full description.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional: One or more Workopolis.com search URLs. If provided, these are used instead of keyword/location.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job search keyword(s). Examples: 'Software Developer', 'Data Analyst', 'Nurse'

location.title: Location
location.description: Location to search. Leave empty to search nationwide. Examples: 'Toronto', 'Vancouver', 'Calgary'

results_wanted.title: Maximum Jobs
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages
max_pages.description: Safety limit on pages to crawl
